mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.stated_objective_pain_point: Manage increasing CubeSat complexity, make change impacts less obscure, preserve student educational value, reduce design-cycle time, and provide a simple standardized build/model template.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.system_boundary_level_of_abstraction: CSRM-derived PSAT1U baseline covers domain/enterprise/segment, space and ground segment packages, subsystem/component packages, interfaces and relationships; mission-specific payload and mission modules are intentionally left undefined and constrained by an envelope.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.required_prior_behavioral_domain_knowled: Users need mission objectives and payload-specific information to tailor the template; well-understood subsystems/components are pre-modeled by faculty/experts, reducing the need for novice students to understand full MBSE creation or repeat subsystem trades.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.artifact_notes: Other artifacts include CSRM/model package templates, architecture hierarchy/package diagrams, subsystem/component specification dialogs, documentation tabs, and relations views.

implementation_steps_or_phases.description: Select CSRM as the CubeSat-specific MBSE starting point/template.
implementation_steps_or_phases.evidence: CSRM was chosen as a CubeSat specific template (line 80).

implementation_steps_or_phases.description: Open CSRM in Cameo Systems Modeler V19.0; review predefined packages/templates.
implementation_steps_or_phases.evidence: The CSRM was obtained and accessed using CAMEO Systems Modeler MBSE Software V19.0 (line 334).

implementation_steps_or_phases.description: Append/adapt the CSRM architecture with PSAT1U-specific information and define architecture hierarchy/subsystem packages.
implementation_steps_or_phases.evidence: architecture was appended to include specific information describing PSAT1U (line 334).

implementation_steps_or_phases.description: Populate subsystem/component artifacts, including ADCS BDD, EPS package, power budget documentation, and relationships among components/subsystems.
implementation_steps_or_phases.evidence: Figure 15 is the package diagram describing the EPS... as-designed power budget (line 374).

implementation_steps_or_phases.description: Demonstrate use: edit specifications, rely on model relationships for change propagation, and tailor generic payload/mission specification to create mission-specific PSAT1U instances.
implementation_steps_or_phases.evidence: by adding the appropriate payload and mission details... the user will create a model of their mission specific instance (line 483).

implementation_pathway_tailoring.mapping_to_se_activities_lifecycle_gates: Maps to requirements/stakeholder needs, logical and physical architecture, mission design/development, subsystem design information, and classroom capstone implementation; no explicit SRR/PDR/CDR gate mapping.

named_tool_versions: CAMEO Systems Modeler MBSE Software V19.0
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.toolchain_architecture_data_flow: Single-tool CSRM/Cameo workflow: CSRM packages/templates are reviewed and appended with PSAT1U information; mission-specific users add requirements/payload details to the baseline. Physical CAD/EZNEC/engineering diagrams appear in the paper but are not reported as integrated with the MBSE model.
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.syntax_semantic_continuity_across_lifecy: Continuity is shown within the model through package hierarchy and relationships/change propagation; no cross-lifecycle toolchain continuity or downstream engineering synchronization is reported.
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.software_hardware_system_integration_rea: No direct toolchain support for software/hardware integration is reported; the model helps expose subsystem/component interfaces and payload constraints.
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.availability_reproducibility: CSRM starting point and Cameo tool are named; PSAT1U model, data, scripts, and open reusable packages are not reported as available.

eps_verification_specific.eps_requirements_representation_and_link: EPS architecture and power budget are included in the EPS package/specification; payload envelope requires operating within available daylight power. The paper does not show formal requirements-to-EPS trace tables or verification links.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text_or_paraphrase: A CSRM-derived standardized MBSE template can make CubeSat design cycles more efficient and reduce future design/development time by preventing repeated trade studies on well-understood subsystems/components.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_or_process_linked_to_claim: CSRM-based PSAT1U standardized template/baseline model used as a starting point for mission-specific CubeSats.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Qualitative expected reduction in design/development time; no measured effect size.

evidence_source.quote: The aim of this model is to aid in the education of undergraduate engineering students in their capstone design course as well as to reduce design and development times for future CubeSat systems.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: No time/effort metrics, baseline project, or student/team evaluation; the physical PSAT1U standard design itself may also reduce trade-study effort independent of MBSE.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text_or_paraphrase: The baseline model defines PSAT1U subsystems/components/interfaces while leaving payload and mission modules undefined, helping users understand the payload design space and create mission-specific instances.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_or_process_linked_to_claim: PSAT1U Baseline Model, mission payload BDD, generic payload specification, and editable payload documentation/specification.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Qualitatively claimed clearer payload design space and model tailoring; no reuse count or validation.

evidence_source.quote: The baseline model is unique in that it defines all of the important subsystems, components, and interfaces of the PSAT1U, but leaves the payload and mission specific modules undefined.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: The paper demonstrates editing payload documentation but does not show successful independent reuse by other teams or missions.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text_or_paraphrase: Model relationships automatically propagate a Watchdog Timer specification change from ADCS to the Power subsystem and other related elements, avoiding manual propagation and improving consistency/traceability.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_or_process_linked_to_claim: Cameo model relationship between Watchdog Timer Reset Circuit, ADCS subsystem, and Power subsystem.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Concrete model relationship shown; authors claim no manual propagation is needed. No metric for avoided errors or time saved.

evidence_source.quote: As a result, any changes made to the Watchdog Timer specification are automatically propagated to the Power subsystem and to any other subsystems or components with a relationship to the Watchdog Timer. The user does not need to manually propagate this change.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: The demonstration is a single illustrative trace; it does not verify semantic correctness, requirements impact, or effects in a changing project over time.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text_or_paraphrase: Storing critical PSAT1U design information inside model documentation tabs makes it viewable/editable by practitioners and supports shared understanding.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_or_process_linked_to_claim: Subsystem/component specification documentation tabs, including EPS power budget and payload envelope information.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Qualitative claim that critical design information is stored, viewable, and editable in the model.

evidence_source.quote: The model stores design specifics of the PSAT1U as text data within the documentation tab of the appropriate subsystem or component specification. In this way, critical design information is stored in the model and can be viewed or edited as needed by practitioners.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: Storing information as text documentation may not provide formal analyzability or consistency checking; no user evidence is reported.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text_or_paraphrase: The faculty-prepared template lets students and discipline experts benefit from MBSE tools without becoming MBSE experts, allowing them to focus on analysis, testing, and mission-critical decisions.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_or_process_linked_to_claim: Classroom deployment of a constrained PSAT1U standardized MBSE template prepared by faculty.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Expected educational/adoption benefit only; no classroom outcome data.

evidence_source.quote: This approach... will also allow subject matter experts in aerospace engineering and other specific disciplines to gain the benefit of these powerful systems engineering tools without becoming expert MBSE users.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: The paper does not report actual student use, surveys, learning outcomes, design decisions, or comparison to a non-template course.

governance_roi_project_decision_linkage.traceability_to_project_deliverables_or_: Relations among model elements are shown for change propagation; no explicit deliverable, milestone, assurance-case, or management-report traceability is reported.
governance_roi_project_decision_linkage.evaluation_criteria_model_quality_useful: Implicit usefulness criteria are design-space clarity, ability to tailor payload/mission details, and automatic propagation of changes; no formal model-quality criteria or user evaluation.
governance_roi_project_decision_linkage.model_derived_performance_indicators_man: Power budget/margins and payload envelope are captured, but no management metrics are reported.

key_findings_by_rq.RQ1: Strongly relevant: demonstrates a CSRM-derived reusable 1U CubeSat baseline/template with system/subsystem architecture, interfaces, EPS budget, and intentionally undefined payload/mission envelope for tailoring.
key_findings_by_rq.RQ2: Partially relevant: claims MBSE improves reuse, design-space understanding, change propagation, consistency, and time/effort, but evidence is illustrative and not EPS-specific; reliability statements concern hardware choices rather than MBSE.
key_findings_by_rq.RQ3: Not relevant: no EPS verification procedure model, V&V artifact integration, executable checks, or pre-physical verification mechanism is reported.

author_stated_limitations_gaps: Students cannot be expected to learn full MBSE/tools within the capstone course; faculty pre-constrain the model.
Payload and mission definitions are intentionally left blank and must remain within the template envelope.
extractor_identified_limitations_gaps: No quantitative MBSE outcome evaluation or baseline comparator.
No independent classroom/user validation or repeated reuse evidence.
No integrated EPS verification procedures or executable checks.
No PSAT1U model availability or neutral exchange mechanism reported.
Single PSAT1U/USNA case within CSRM lineage.

direct_evidence_quotes_supporting_classi.quote: The PSAT1U Baseline Model is an MBSE representation of the satellite developed using the CSRM as a starting point.
Within the specification for the EPS, pertinent information such as the as-designed power budget (Figure 16) is also available.
The user does not need to manually propagate this change.
It is beyond the scope of this course to teach these students all there is to know about MBSE and how to utilize its tools.

synthesis_consistency.notes_for_lineage_consistency: Treat as an application/instantiation of the CSRM family rather than an independent reference-model origin paper. Outcome claims overlap with CSRM reuse/template rationale but are specific to PSAT1U classroom/future-use context.
synthesis_consistency.extraction_confidence_reason: Full markdown is readable and detailed for context and model artifacts; confidence is high for coding but outcome-evidence strength remains low/medium because the paper itself is mostly illustrative.
